en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a city street scene with a grand multi‑story hotel on the left labeled "Palast-Hotel Weber" and an adjacent large theater building with a high, blocky roof. People walk across an open square and an old electric tram marked with the number 506 runs on the right. At the top in red script is printed "Dresden" on the left and "Palast-Hôtel und Kgl. Schauspielhaus" on the right.
